_notes: Framework MSA: SOW mechanism + order of precedence are the type-defining clauses; commercial terms per engagement live in SOWs.

conditional_clauses.note: Master service levels applying across SOWs
DPDPA 2023 compliance — required if services involve personal data

mandatory_legal_checks: Indian Contract Act 1872 S.10 — each SOW must satisfy contract-formation essentials
Stamp duty — MSA and each SOW may attract state stamp duty as separate instruments
GST — place-of-supply and invoicing terms should be settled per SOW
TDS S.194J/194C — deduction obligations depend on the nature of services in each SOW
MSME Act 2006 — payment timelines apply where the provider is a registered MSME
